header.title: How to Install LED Recessed Lights
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely install LED recessed lights in your ceiling. Learn the necessary preparations and electrical connections to achieve a professional lighting upgrade.

steps.description: Ensure electrical safety by turning off the circuit breaker, verifying insulation, and placing the junction box in an accessible location.
actions: Turn off the circuit breaker at the main panel
Verify that insulation doesn't touch the light trim
Verify that insulation doesn't touch the housing unit
Verify that insulation doesn't touch the light bulb
Place the junction box in an easy to access location
steps.part: circuit breaker, insulation, light trim, housing unit, light bulb, junction box

steps.description: Locate ceiling joists, trace the fixture shape, and cut the hole in the ceiling.
actions: Turn off the circuit breaker at the main electrical panel
Use a stud finder to find ceiling joists
Trace an appropriate shape and size for the lighting fixture
Place a trap for debris directly underneath the tracing
Cut the tracing with a drywall saw, drywall circle cutter, or a jigsaw

steps.description: This step involves connecting the electrical cable from the previous fixture to the new LED fixture, ensuring proper wire connections and grounding.
actions: Bring an electrical feed cable from the previous light fixture's electrical box to the newly cut opening location
Pass the cable through a knockout inside the LED fixture box
Secure the electrical cable in place with a cable clamp, leaving 6 to 8" of wire inside the box
Remove the jacket from the cable
Strip 3/4" of insulation from the infeed wires
Connect the black wire of the fixture to the black wire of the 110V feed cable using wire connectors
Connect the white wire of the fixture to the white wire of the 110V feed cable using wire connectors
Connect the green wire (ground) of the fixture to the green wire (ground) of the 110V feed cable, ensuring it is grounded to the box
Fasten the electrical cable into the fixture’s junction box with the cable clamp
Connect the fixture’s black wire to the black wire of the house
Connect the fixture’s white wire to the white wire of the house
Connect the fixture’s green wire (ground) to the ground or green wire of the house
Put the wires into the box
Fasten the cover

steps.description: Secure the fixture cover, engage the mounting tabs, and test the lights after restoring power.
actions: Push the wires into the box
Fasten the cover
Rotate the fixture into place
Engage the mounting tabs
Follow the fixture's manual
Restore power
Test the lights
